description: Personal build of HushTelegram 0.0.20 (68 patches) for Telegram 13.1.0 - both the Google Play build (org.telegram.messenger, version code 72291) and the telegram.org build (org.telegram.messenger.web, 72299). Based on SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram (GPL-3.0), plus: Vietnamese translation of the HushTelegram settings, a Quiet hours patch (silences non-service chats on a schedule), per-chat download folders in Save downloaded files, a Quiet Pack quick setup, and quieter personal defaults. Needs Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK.
